2225-4823-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-4823-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2103-2707-7817.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Paradox Shaper by paying {2}, causing you to put Capture of Jingzhou on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

1174-3664-3869-4893.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least one mana.
1174-3664-3869-4893.description:
Activate another land that enters untapped by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {1} due to Training Grounds and returning the land tapped in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Lotus Field.
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}
Activate Gretchen by paying {G}{U} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card and put the land returned to hand in step 2 onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

803-5330-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-5330-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

512-1719-5724.easyPrerequisites: Sage of the Maze and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-5724.description:
Activate Sage of the Maze by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Sage of the Maze, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

147-413-1070.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-1070.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Rise Again.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

412-3081-3817-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

985-5078-7729.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat

193-2724-3080-4450-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
193-2724-3080-4450-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Aminatou by putting 0 loyalty counter on them due to Carth the Lion, blinking Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

3688-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
3688-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
3688-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-5223-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

773-851-1409.description:
Activate Galazeth Prismari by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Galazeth Prismari enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Galazeth Prismari.
Resolve the Galazeth Prismari trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

486-1978-3443.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
486-1978-3443.description:
Cause Deathbloom Ritualist to become an artifact using Liquimetal Torque.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

359-372-1031.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver exiled by Abdel Adrian.
359-372-1031.description:
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Acrobatic Maneuver from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Acrobatic Maneuver.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6441-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1029-2107-5028.description:
Activate Sunastian Falconer by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Sunastian Falconer.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-2107-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

1322-2457-4094-4289.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1322-2457-4094-4289.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-3908-5403.description:
Cast Oko by paying {2}{G}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield with six loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Oko, and to enter the battlefield with eight loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate an Oko's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, causing you to create two token copies of each other nonland permanent you control.
If you created any legenedary tokens this way, put all but one of them into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3 using a different Oko.
Once you have infinite Oko tokens, you may instead activate Oko's other abilities.

947-1132-1305-3809.description:
Cast Heaven Sent by paying {U}{R}.
Widespread Thieving triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U} or {R}{R}.
Resolve Heaven Sent, choosing to have it enter the battlefield with three chapter counters on it due to its read ahead ability.
Heaven Sent's third chapter ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent, and causing you to draw seven cards if an opponent has 0 or less life, or otherwise exile Heaven Sent with the ability to play it this turn.
If Heaven Sent was exiled this way, repeat until Heaven Sent is not exiled.

1467-1770-2104-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1467-1770-2104-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3129-3209-4214-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

1789-2232-4336-4875.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters the battlefield, Lathliss and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-3861-3875.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3861-3875.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Tireless Provisioner, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

57-1402-2178-2584.notablePrerequisites:
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
57-1402-2178-2584.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Diamond Lion with haste.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage equal to Diamond Lion's power to any target.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, discarding your hand, and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Thornbite Staff triggers, untapping Feldon of the Third Path.
Repeat.

2522-2655.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from your command zone this game.
An additional instant or sorcery in hand with the mana to cast it, or an opponent has cast an as of yet unresolved instant or sorcery spell.
2522-2655.description:
Cast your additional instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Cast Fury Storm targeting the instant or sorcery spell.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Fury Storm triggers, copying itself for each time you have cast your commander from your command zone this game and choosing the original copy of Fury Storm as the target.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers for each copy, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life each time.
Resolve a Fury Storm copy, copying Fury Storm and choosing the original Fury Storm as the target.
Witherbloom Apprentice triggers, losing each opponent 1 life and gaining you 1 life.
Repeat from step 7.

3573-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
You control at least two artifacts.
3573-4222-4644.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
